say:1:1910108001:0.text: What do you mean "stay out of the water"? Are we supposed to cower in our homes just because we're afraid?
say:1:1910108001:0.source_cn: 少出海是什么意思？我们不能因为惧怕海，就缩在村里！

say:2:1910108002:1.text: How are we supposed to get food? Where do we get fresh leather and seaweed?
say:2:1910108002:1.source_cn: 不然食物从哪里来？新的皮革和海藻又从哪里找？

say:3:1910108003:1.text: Have you forgotten who we are?! The people of Kaflan <style="highlight">respect the sea, but we never bow to it</style>!
say:3:1910108003:1.source_cn: 我看你是吓破了胆子，都忘了我们对海的态度——卡什澜人<...

say:4:1910108004:1.text: If the waves hit hard, we build stronger boats! If the tides go wild, we learn their new rules! That is how you respect the sea!
say:4:1910108004:1.source_cn: 海浪太大，那就造更好的船战胜它。潮汐乱了，那就研究新规...

say:5:1910108005:1.text: Alright, alright, old man. Shouting isn't going to change anything.
say:5:1910108005:1.source_cn: 好了好了，老爹你喊这么大声有什么用？

say:6:1910108006:1.text: We get it, but the tides are different every day now. No wooden boat, no matter how sturdy, can take giant waves crashing into it from every direction.
say:6:1910108006:1.source_cn: 道理咱都懂，但现在的潮汐规律每天都不一样。再厉害的木舟...

say:7:1910108007:1.text: The hunting and fishing teams agree. The sea's too dangerous right now, so no one's allowed out. We're putting the boats away for now, Pops.
say:7:1910108007:1.source_cn: 渔猎队也是这么说的，海上不太平，最近几天都不许擅自出海...

say:8:1910108008:1.text: Y-you little rascal! Don't you dare touch my boat! You hear me?!
say:8:1910108008:1.source_cn: 你……你这娃子！不许动我的船！听见没有！
